errors.text: The proposed 1300°C homogenization and quench differs substantially from the target regime of vacuum sintering at 1400°C for 18 hours followed by water quenching from 1500°C.
The predicted sub-micron-to-few-micron grain size is inconsistent with the target result of 33 ± 19 µm.
The hypothesis treats oxygen below 0.8 wt.% as necessary, whereas the target process retains approximately 1.0 wt.% oxygen and attributes useful interstitial strengthening to that controlled uptake.

Elemental Ti powder is described as producing TiO/TiO2 precipitates in or near the alloy, rather than reconstructing the external titanium-sponge getter configuration; this could alter alloy composition or introduce oxide contamination.
The required long sintering hold and hydrogen de-binding step are omitted.
